"''It will be.|Niro and Cad Bane|}} '''Niro''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Duros]] who lived during the later [[Republic Era]]. Niro grew up as an orphan on the streets of a [[Unidentified city (Cad Bane)|crime ridden city]] together with his friend [[Cad Bane|Colby]]. After the two helped a [[Cad Bane's gang|criminal gang]] led by a Duros man called [[Lazlo]] [[Raid on The Corner Shop|raid]] a [[The Corner Shop|local grocery store and casino]], Niro was captured by the arriving [[Unidentified police droid model|police droids]], while Colby was able to flee with the gang. Years later, Niro had become a deputy in the [[Unidentified police force|local police force]], serving under [[Unidentified marshal|a]] [[human]] marshal. After the marshal killed Lazlo during a heist, Colby, now known under the name "Cad Bane", returned to the city together with his girlfriend [[Arin]] to take revenge. On the old streets where they once lived, Bane met Niro again and embraced him, before Niro told him that he was now a police officer, which angered Bane. Later that night, Bane met the marshal and managed to kill him in a [[Showdown in an unidentified city|showdown]], but Arin was wounded and Bane gave up and was captured. The following years, Niro was promoted to marshal. He got in a relationship with Arin and the two together raised her and Bane's son [[Isaac]], before Arin eventually passed away. After Bane was released early from his [[Prison|imprisonment]] on [[Torano]], he returned to the city to take revenge and in a [[Second showdown in an unidentified city|showdown]] in front of [[Unidentified police station|the police station]], shot Niro dead, leaving Isaac an orphan. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Niro first appeared via the trailer for the [[2025]] [[Disney+]] animated miniseries series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'' and had his name confirmed by its [[Disney+]] subtitles.{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}} He debuted in "[[The Good Life]]," the fourth episode of the series, which premiered on [[May 4]], [[2025]].
